lessons.text: In the AP mail system (http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail), open the email and inspect sender and attachments before any ERP write; then query ERP GET /vendors?q=<vendor_name> to get the registered email_domain and compare exact string to the sender domain. If the domain does not match exactly, stop and report suspected fraud without creating a bill.

Look-alike sender domains (e.g. digit '1' instead of letter 'l' in a legitimate vendor domain) can pass visual check; always compare the sender domain string exactly against the ERP vendor email_domain. A mismatch plus bank-detail instructions in the email is a confirmed fraud stop.

When a policy stop condition triggers (sender mismatch, bank-change instruction, no attachment), open http://127.0.0.1:8765/mail/compose, fill To=priya.nair@kestrel.in, Subject starting with 'SUSPECTED FRAUD:', and include vendor, invoice number, claimed amount, no bill ID/payment date; click Send. Do not record the bill or schedule payment.
The AP lead email address is priya.nair@kestrel.in for all invoice-processing notifications and fraud/stop reports.
The ERP exposes GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number> to check for existing bills before recording; a 200 with empty result means no duplicate exists.
